Do not use when: files (use file_find), tasks (use task_search), the internet (use web_search). Examples: «search my notes for the word thesis», «which note did I put Juan's phone number in?», «search notes for recipe».
tools.note.trash: Delete a note by its title, moving it to a recoverable trash; a title no note bears deletes nothing and its result names the titles close to it, if any, so call it with the title said rather than asking which note. Use when: delete the note X. Do not use when: a task (use task_delete), a file (use filesystem_known_trash_named). Examples: «delete the ideas note», «remove the shopping note», «delete note thesis».
tools.note.update: Change an existing note: its title and its content are both replaced by what is sent (note_list does not return the content, so read it with note_read and send it again when only the title changes). Use when: change or edit the note X. Do not use when: a new note (use note_create), a task (use task_update). Examples: «change the ideas note to 'call the teacher'», «edit the shopping note: milk and bread», «rename the thesis note to project».
tools.ocr.read: Read the text that appears in a screenshot already taken (by its capture id). Only the last 16 captures are kept; an older id gives capture_not_found. With much text the words' boxes are left out (layout available false) and the text stays. Use when: the text on screen or in a capture is wanted. Do not use when: describing what is seen (use vision_describe), the open web page (use browser_page_read), no capture yet (use capture_screenshot first). Examples: «read the text in the capture», «what does it say on the screen?», «run OCR on the capture».
tools.office.document.create: Create a new Office document, Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx), with a title, in Documents\BAXY; for Word, paragraphs is its text, one paragraph per entry and per line in it (Excel takes none: refused). Your whole call must fit in one answer of yours, so about 350 words of text at most: a longer one does not fit and nothing is written, so write a shorter text and tell the person its length. The result gives the file's name and, with paragraphs, how many paragraphs and words below the title the reread file holds. The file is written without opening Word: to show it (the person asked to open Word or to see the text), open it afterwards with file_open, folder documents and name «BAXY\» followed by the result's name, foreground true. Use when: create a Word document or an Excel spreadsheet; a text to write in Word (a story, a letter, an essay), also when the person asks to open Word to write it: write the whole text in paragraphs here, never key by key in Word's window. Do not use when: a PowerPoint (use document_presentation_create), a plain text file (use file_write), opening Word or Excel when no document or text was asked for (use app_open). Examples: «create a word document called report», «write a letter to my boss in word», «make an excel spreadsheet of expenses», «new word doc thesis».
tools.office.document.read: Read the content of an already identified Office document. Use when: reading a document created or identified earlier. Do not use when: a PDF or a text file (use file_read). Examples: «read that document», «what does the word document you created say?», «read that doc».
tools.package.install: Install a normal program on the PC with winget and verify it is installed, after confirmation. packageId is the winget id (Spotify.Spotify) or the program's name as the person said it (spotify, vlc). A name that is not exactly one package installs nothing and lists the candidates winget gave (name, packageId, packageSource; candidateCount says how many, truncated past the eight listed): call again with the packageId the person wants, or ask which. alreadyInstalled true: it was there and nothing ran. winget_install_still_running: the installer started and has not finished: say it is installing, not that it is installed. Use when: install, download and install or put in a program. Do not use when: uninstalling (use package_uninstall), a Steam or Epic game (use game_install_named), opening it (use app_open). Examples: «install spotify», «download vlc for me», «install 7-zip».
tools.package.uninstall: Uninstall a normal program from the PC by its name and verify it is gone, after confirmation. At most 8 candidates come back (candidateCount, truncated); after 12 seconds the result says winget_uninstall_still_running (it goes on uninstalling). Use when: uninstall a program. Do not use when: installing (use package_install), a Steam game (use game_uninstall_named), closing it (use app_close). Examples: «uninstall discord», «remove zoom from the pc», «uninstall vlc».
tools.peripheral.list: List peripherals, optionally of one kind: mice, keyboards and USB devices present now, scanners available, and printers installed (their queues, virtual ones such as PDF included, with Windows' status). A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Mice and keyboards come before the USB devices. Use when: what peripherals are there or is a mouse connected or a printer installed. Do not use when: USB drives and free space (use storage_removable_list), Bluetooth devices (use bluetooth_device_list), monitors (use display_status). Examples: «what peripherals are connected?», «is there a printer connected?», «list the usb devices».
tools.peripheral.print: Print an already identified document on a printer. Use when: print. Do not use when: listing printers (use peripheral_list). Examples: «print that document», «send it to the printer», «print it».
tools.peripheral.scan: Scan a document with a scanner. Use when: scan. Do not use when: a screenshot (use capture_screenshot), reading text from a capture (use ocr_read). Examples: «scan this document», «use the scanner», «scan a page».
tools.schedule.alarms: Set, list or cancel BAXY's alarms and reminders, which ring on this PC (Windows Task Scheduler; also on battery, and from sleep only where the power plan allows wake timers; not when it is shut down), or check why one did not ring. Use when: an alarm, a timer, a wake-up or a reminder at a time or in some minutes, which ones are set, or cancelling one. Do not use when: a to-do without a time (use task_create), a calendar event (use calendar_event_create), a note (use note_create). How to fill it: action create needs title and either inMinutes (minutes from now), inSeconds (seconds, for a short timer) or at (the local time in 24 hours, HH:mm, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm for another day); a time counted from now (in a minute, in half an hour, in 90 seconds) goes as inMinutes or inSeconds, which the tool counts from now, never as at worked out from the clock; kind alarm for alarms and wake-ups, reminder otherwise; recurrence daily or hourly only when it repeats. action cancel takes the kind of the one meant (alarm for an alarm, reminder by default): with at (HH:mm only) it cancels the one of that kind at that local time, without at the only one pending (with several it cancels none and lists them, and at names the one); list shows the next ones by time, each with its kind (a view shows the next 20 at most; count says how many are set). action stop or snooze answers the one ringing now (a note of the turn says which rings, with its id): stop silences it, also when the person just acknowledges it (thanks, it's done, on my way) (one that repeats still rings next time), snooze rings it again in inMinutes (10 if not said). Examples: «remind me in 20 minutes to take the laundry out» (create, inMinutes 20), «set an alarm for a minute from now» (create, alarm, inMinutes 1), «wake me up tomorrow at 7» (create, alarm, at 07:00), «what alarms do I have» (list), «cancel the 7 o'clock alarm» (cancel, alarm, at 07:00), «Baxy, stop the alarm» while it rings (stop, id), «five more minutes» while it rings (snooze, id, inMinutes 5).
tools.shell.command.run: Run a PowerShell console command and return its output; cwd is desktop, documents, downloads or home, optionally with a folder inside it (documents/project), or a full path; without cwd it runs in a private empty folder; a command that does more than read (writes, deletes, installs, sends, runs a program) waits for the person's yes. It is stopped after 60 seconds (shell_command_timeout); only the first 8,192 characters of output come back (truncated true), so a summary printed at the end may be cut; output past about one million characters stops the command and nothing of it comes back (shell_command_output_too_large). Use when: execute or run a command. Do not use when: a dedicated operation exists (system_process_list, network_ping, app_open). Examples: «execute ls on the desktop», «run pytest in documents/project», «run git status».
tools.software.python.package.status: Check whether a Python package is installed, and its version, in each Python registered in Windows (PEP 514), by asking its pip, without installing anything; a pip that did not answer leaves that Python unread. Use when: do I have X installed for a Python package. Do not use when: which Python versions exist (use software_python_status), normal apps (use app_installed). Examples: «do I have numpy installed?», «what version of pandas do I have?», «is requests installed?».
tools.software.python.status: List the Python versions registered in Windows (the PEP 514 registry keys the python.org and Store installers write); a Python outside that registry (pyenv, portable, conda without registration) is not seen. Use when: what python do I have. Do not use when: a Python package (use software_python_package_status). Examples: «what version of python do I have?», «is python installed?», «python versions?».
tools.storage.removable.list: List the removable drives connected now (USB sticks, SD cards) and their free space; an external USB disk Windows sees as fixed is not listed. Use when: is there a USB stick or how much space is left on the USB. Do not use when: the internal disk (use system_status), other peripherals (use peripheral_list). Examples: «is there a USB stick connected?», «how much space is left on the usb?».
tools.streaming.navigate: Go to an exact content address on a streaming service (Netflix, HBO Max, Prime Video, YouTube), without searching by title. Use when: a specific streaming link or id is already known. Do not use when: a title is named (use streaming_play_named), a YouTube search (use media_play_youtube). Examples: «open this netflix link: netflix.com/watch/123», «go to that hbo max address», «open this prime video link».
tools.streaming.play.named: Play a movie or series by its title on Netflix, Disney+ or HBO Max and verify it plays: in BAXY's own browser by the video advancing, in the person's browser by the system's media session saying playing. Only the search result named as title (case and accents aside) is opened: write the title as the service names it; when none is, nothing plays and the search page's links and buttons (menus included; in the person's browser only those holding the title when any do, and the first 10) come back as candidates. A «who is watching» profile screen stops it: the person picks the profile. Use when: a film or series title is named. Do not use when: music (use media_play_query or media_play_exact), YouTube videos (use media_play_youtube), only opening the Netflix app (use app_open). Examples: «put on stranger things on netflix», «I want to watch Moana on disney plus», «play The Last of Us on hbo max».
tools.system.application.crash.diagnose: Report recent Windows Error Reporting events: application crashes and hangs, and other reports Windows files the same way (an update failure, a kernel event), each under its report's name. It looks at the last 24 hours, 20 events by default; its counts stop at four times limit (80 by default, 200 at most), so they are no total. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: why did an app close by itself or which apps froze. Do not use when: running processes (use system_process_list), alarms not ringing (use schedule_alarms). Examples: «which apps crashed today?», «why did chrome close?», «any app crashes recently?».
tools.system.identity: Read which Windows user account BAXY runs under; it does not tell the person's name. Use when: under which Windows user. Do not use when: the person's own name (use memory_recall). Examples: «which windows account do you run under?», «which windows user is this?», «whoami».
tools.system.power: Lock, sign out, sleep, shut down or restart the PC. Use when: shut down, restart, lock or sleep the PC, or sign out of the Windows account (action signout). Do not use when: turning the screen or a monitor off (use display_monitor_set: locking does not turn the screen off), closing apps (use app_close or window_close_all), signing out of one app or website (that is done inside it), restarting one (app_restart), radios (use wifi_radio_set or bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «turn off the pc», «restart the computer», «lock the computer». Never use it to silence, mute or lower sound: that is audio_mute. Turning the PC off is only for turn off the PC or shut down.
tools.system.process.list: List running processes, sorted by CPU, memory or name. 10 by default (observedProcessCount is the total). Use when: which processes are running or what uses the most. Do not use when: whether one app has an open window (use window_application_status), overall CPU or RAM (use system_status). Examples: «which processes use the most memory?», «list the running programs», «top cpu processes».
tools.system.process.terminate.named: Force-kill a program by its executable name, with confirmation; this is not a normal window close. Use when: kill, force-close or the program is not responding. Do not use when: a normal close of an app (use app_close), closing all windows (use window_close_all). Examples: «force-close chrome.exe», «kill the spotify process», «kill discord, it froze».
tools.system.recyclebin.empty: Empty the Windows Recycle Bin. Use when: empty the bin. Do not use when: deleting one file (use filesystem_known_trash_named). Examples: «empty the bin», «clear out the recycle bin», «empty recycle bin».
tools.system.settings.adjust: Raise or lower screen brightness by an amount from its current level. Use when: raise or lower the brightness with an amount. Do not use when: a target brightness level is given (use system_settings_set), volume (use audio_volume_adjust). Examples: «raise the brightness 20», «lower the brightness by 10», «brightness down 15».
tools.system.settings.set: Set brightness to a level, or turn Windows' do-not-disturb or airplane mode (every Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and mobile radio off or on, through the radio API) on or off; can also turn BAXY's confirmation bypass off. Do-not-disturb goes through Windows Settings: its Notifications page opens, takes the front and is left open (settingsWindowOpened), also when the setting already was so or on a failure. Use when: brightness to N, do not disturb, airplane mode. Do not use when: brightness by an amount (use system_settings_adjust), Wi-Fi or Bluetooth alone (use wifi_radio_set or bluetooth_radio_set), BAXY's own accessible mode, voice or overlay (use baxy_settings_set). Examples: «set the brightness to 70», «turn on airplane mode», «turn on do not disturb».
tools.system.settings.status: Read the current screen brightness, or for airplane mode whether every Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and mobile radio is off (allRadiosOff; Windows' own airplane switch is not read), or Windows' light or dark mode (setting color_mode; a theme's name in Settings is not the mode), without changing it. Use when: what the brightness is at, whether the mode is light or dark, even with Settings open or asked to open. Do not use when: changing it (use system_settings_set or system_settings_adjust). Examples: «what's the brightness at?», «how bright is the screen?», «is airplane mode on?», «do I have dark mode on?».
tools.system.status: Read PC status: CPU, memory, the system drive (C:, not other drives), battery, graphics card and Windows; scope firewall: its profiles and which are on; scope updates: a pending restart and the updates waiting at Windows' last search (from its cache, no new search; first 10 titles). Use when: battery, RAM, disk, specs, firewall or Windows updates questions. Do not use when: per-process usage (use system_process_list), monitors (use display_status), USB drives (use storage_removable_list). Examples: «how much battery do I have?», «how much ram am I using?», «what graphics card do I have?».
tools.system.time: Read the current date and time, here or in another place or time zone, and work out dates. Use when: what time is it or what day is it; and whenever the answer is a date, a weekday or a number of days other than today's own, in any language: the clock line only says today, and days or weekdays counted by you come out wrong. daysFromToday gives the date that many days away, ahead or back; month and day give that date's weekday and how many days away it is; weekday gives the dates that weekday falls on. Answer from the result's calendar. Do not use when: weather, «what's the weather like» included (use weather_current), setting an alarm (use schedule_alarms), the calendar (use calendar_event_list). Examples: «what time is it?», «what time is it in Tokyo?», «what's the date today?», «what's the date in fifteen days?» (daysFromToday 15), «what day does November 27 fall on?» (month 11, day 27), «how many days until Christmas?» (month 12, day 25). Always use it for the time or date in another city or country; never state another place's time from memory.
tools.task.complete: Mark a to-do as done or cross an item off a list. Use when: I already did it or cross off X. Do not use when: deleting it (use task_delete). Examples: «mark the task pay the electricity bill as done», «cross the bread off the grocery list», «done with the report task».
tools.task.create: Create a to-do; tasks have no separate lists (task_list shows them all together), and its optional date schedules no notification. Use when: put it on my to-do list or add a task. Do not use when: it must ring or remind at a time (use schedule_alarms), free-text notes (use note_create), a calendar event (use calendar_event_create). Examples: «jot down buy milk», «put call the bank on my to-do list», «add task finish the report».
tools.task.delete: Delete a task or remove an item from a list, moving it to a recoverable trash. Use when: delete or remove X from the list. Do not use when: marking it done (use task_complete), a note (use note_trash). Examples: «take the bread off the list», «delete the report task», «delete task bank».
tools.task.list: List tasks, all in one list (there are no separate lists): open, done or deleted. 20 by default (totalCount); without status only open tasks are listed. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: what do I have pending. Do not use when: alarms or reminders (use schedule_alarms), the calendar (use calendar_event_list), notes (use note_list). Examples: «what do I have pending?», «read me my tasks», «show completed tasks».
tools.task.reopen: Reopen a task that had been marked as done. Use when: unmark or it was not done after all. Do not use when: restoring a deleted task (use task_restore). Examples: «reopen the report task», «unmark the bread, I didn't buy it», «reopen task bank».
tools.task.restore: Restore a deleted task. Use when: recover the task I deleted. Do not use when: reopening a completed task (use task_reopen). Examples: «recover the task I deleted», «restore call the bank», «undelete task report».
tools.task.search: Search the tasks whose title or details contain a text. 20 by default (totalCount); deleted tasks are not searched. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: search in my tasks. Do not use when: notes (use note_search), files (use file_find). Examples: «search for tasks about the thesis», «do I have any task with bank?», «search tasks report».
tools.task.update: Change a task: title, details and date are all replaced by what is sent (task_list does not return the details, so changing only the date clears them unless they are sent again). Use when: change the date or the name of the task X. Do not use when: marking it done (use task_complete), a note (use note_update). Examples: «move the report task to Monday», «rename the bank task to go to the bank», «update task bread: two rolls».
tools.vision.describe: Describe what is seen in a screenshot already taken (by its capture id), only with a local vision model configured on this PC: without one it fails with vision_provider_not_configured, so say you cannot see images. Only the last 16 captures are kept; an older id gives capture_not_found. Use when: what do you see on the screen or describe the capture. Do not use when: only the text (use ocr_read), the clickable controls (use input_visible_controls), no capture exists yet (use capture_screenshot first). Examples: «what do you see in the capture?», «describe what is on screen», «what's on my screen?».
tools.weather.current: Read the current weather and tomorrow's forecast, here or in a named place. Without location, «here» is this PC's city as a public service places it by its internet address (approximate; locatedBy says so); the person did not say where they are. location is the place's own name, optionally with a comma and its region or country («Valencia, Spain», «Foster City, California»); only a place named exactly so is read. With several places of comparable size of that name, or none, nothing is read and they come back as candidates (name, region, country; the first 8, candidateCount says how many): ask which one, or call again with the region or country. Use when: weather, what is it like out, temperature, is it going to rain, or whether to take an umbrella or a jacket. Do not use when: news (use web_search), the time (use system_time). Examples: «how's the weather?», «is it going to rain tomorrow in Santiago?», «weather in Valparaíso».
tools.web.download: Download a file or image from the internet into a known folder (Downloads by default), by its public web address (url; never this PC or the local network); the address of a web page downloads the image that page announces as its cover. Files over 50 MiB are not downloaded (download_too_large). Without an address, find one first with web_search and download a result's url. At most 3 redirects. It gives up when the server takes over 40 seconds to answer (each redirect included); the whole download must end within about 100 seconds (what BAXY waits for one operation), or BAXY reports it failed (one ending just after may still be written). Use when: download or pull down a file or image. Do not use when: a game (use game_install_named), just viewing a page (use browser_navigate). Examples: «download the cover image of wikipedia.org to the desktop», «download me a meme», «download example.com/manual.pdf».
tools.web.fetch: Read one public web page (http or https) as plain text: title, final address and text (navigation, header, footer, asides, buttons and selects left out; a page that is not HTML is refused, web_fetch_not_html). A long page comes in pages: when hasMore is true, call again with offset set to nextOffset; bodyTruncated true: the page was longer than BAXY reads (1.5 MB, 1,500,000 bytes) and its text stops there. Never call again with the same url and offset: the same text comes back. At most 3 redirects (web_fetch_too_many_redirects). Use when: the person gives a link or asks what a page says, or to read a page a web_search result points to. Do not use when: looking something up (use web_search), showing the page to the person (use browser_navigate), saving a file (use web_download). Examples: «read me this page https://…», «what does the first result say?», «read https://example.com/news».
tools.web.search: Look something up in one public source and return what it returned, as given. «source»: «web» (default): a web search engine, asked in the person's home region as Windows has it, so a local name finds the local thing («region» in the result; without it, the whole world was searched); each result has title, url and snippet. For news, search the web with the person's words (and «news» for the news in general). «encyclopedia»: Wikipedia in «language» (es or en, default es); each article has title, url and its opening lines. «currency»: «from» and «to» are ISO 4217 codes (USD, EUR, CLP, MXN, ARS…), «amount» the number to convert (default 1); returns the rate, its date and the converted amount. For a team's next or last match, search the web with the person's words. «places»: sites of a kind in a place, from OpenStreetMap; «kind» is the kind of site the person asked for, in English, as OpenStreetMap's tag value names it (pharmacy, parking, restaurant, atm), «place» with its city and country (Plaza de Armas, Santiago, Chile); returns names, addresses, distances and each site's «category», its OpenStreetMap tag: a site is what its category says, so a broader kind finds sites of the broader kind, not of the one asked; «matchedBy» «name» means no site had that value and these are sites whose name holds it. «query» always says what you look for; for web and encyclopedia it is the text searched: the person's own words, every name exactly as they said it, even one you do not know (never another that sounds alike), and years as numbers (2026, not this year). «limit»: 1 to 10 results (default 5). «nearby»: true adds this PC's city and country to the query (for places, they are the place, after «place» if given); use it only when the person asks for something near them. Every result says in «answeredBy» the source that answered: when you say where results came from, name that one and no other. Results are not checked against the question: judge them yourself, and to read a result's page call web_fetch with its url. Use when: what changes over time or what you are not sure of: news, prices, schedules, results, currency conversions, a team's next or last match, places near me or in a named place. Do not use when: what you know for sure and does not change (definitions, geography, science, well-known history): answer it yourself; weather (use weather_current), opening a site or results page in the browser (use browser_navigate), playing YouTube (use media_play_youtube). Examples: «what happened in congress today?» → source web, query «congress»; «how much is 100 dollars in Chilean pesos?» → source currency, from USD, to CLP, amount 100; «when does Boca play?» → source web, query «when does Boca play»; «pharmacies near me» → source places, kind «pharmacy», nearby true; «look up reviews of the iPhone 17» → source web. It only reads: never use it to buy, order, book, pay or act for the person; if no tool does that action, say in one sentence you don't.
tools.wifi.connect: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network already identified by its profile id. Use when: the network was identified earlier in the conversation. Do not use when: the network is said by name or by place such as home or work (use wifi_connect_named). Examples: «connect to that network», «yes, connect», «connect to it».
tools.wifi.connect.named: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network by its name, or by its place (casa: home, trabajo: work, oficina: office) once a call that named both the network and the place has taught it; a place not taught yet comes back wifi_place_unknown. Use when: connect to the wifi X or to the home one. Do not use when: turning the Wi-Fi radio on (use wifi_radio_set), seeing networks around (use wifi_scan). Examples: «connect to the home wifi», «connect to the MiCasa5G network», «connect to the work wifi».
tools.wifi.disconnect: Disconnect from the current Wi-Fi network. Use when: disconnect from the wifi. Do not use when: turning the Wi-Fi radio off (use wifi_radio_set). Examples: «disconnect from the wifi», «leave this network», «disconnect wifi».
tools.wifi.ensure.connected: Check that Wi-Fi is already connected, without changing anything. Use when: a step must make sure Wi-Fi is connected. Do not use when: the person simply asks whether they are connected (use wifi_status), connecting (use wifi_connect_named). Examples: «ensure the wifi is connected», «check that I'm still on the wifi», «make sure wifi is connected».
tools.wifi.profile.list: List the Wi-Fi networks saved on the PC. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: which networks do I have saved. Do not use when: networks around now (use wifi_scan). Examples: «which wifi networks do I have saved?», «list my saved networks», «saved wifi networks».
tools.wifi.radio.set: Turn the PC's Wi-Fi on or off. Use when: turn the wifi on or off. Do not use when: leaving one network only (use wifi_disconnect), airplane mode (use system_settings_set), Bluetooth (use bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «turn off the wifi», «switch on the wifi», «turn wifi on».
tools.wifi.radio.status: Read whether Wi-Fi is on or off, without changing it. Use when: is the wifi on. Do not use when: whether it is connected to a network (use wifi_status). Examples: «is the wifi turned on?», «do I have wifi enabled?», «wifi on or off?».
tools.wifi.scan: List the Wi-Fi networks available around now, with their signal. At most 50 networks are read (listedCount when cut; networkCount is how many Windows saw), and a view shows 20 of them (truncated says so). Use when: which networks are available. Do not use when: saved networks (use wifi_profile_list). Examples: «which wifi networks are available?», «look for wifi networks», «scan wifi».
tools.wifi.status: Check whether the PC is connected to a Wi-Fi network right now. Use when: am I connected to the wifi. Do not use when: general internet (use network_status), radio on or off (use wifi_radio_status). Examples: «am I connected to the wifi?», «do I have wifi?», «wifi status».
tools.window.active: Tell which window or application is in the foreground now. Use when: which window is active or in front. Do not use when: whether a named app is open (use window_application_status). Examples: «which window do I have active?», «which program is in front?», «what window is this?».
tools.window.application.status: Check whether a named application is open with a visible window, without opening it. Only applications of the Start catalog are checked: for any other the result says inStartCatalog false and nothing about its windows. Use when: is X open. Do not use when: opening it (use app_open), whether it is installed (use app_installed), which window is in front (use window_active). Examples: «is spotify open?», «do I have chrome open?», «is discord open?».
tools.window.close.all: Close every open window of this desktop (editors and terminals too) but BAXY's own, after the person's yes; never forces: a window that asks to save stays open; windows on another virtual desktop are not touched (cloakedWindows counts them); a desktop window that could not be read is counted in unreadWindows. Use when: close everything or all the windows. Do not use when: one app or one window, the active one included (use app_close), only hiding windows to see the desktop (use window_minimize_all). Examples: «close all the windows», «close it all», «close everything».
tools.window.focus: Bring an open window to the front by the windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the one the last window action gave back (never windowHandle or another number). A windowId expires after 5 minutes (invalid_or_expired_window_id). Use when: switch to, go to or bring to the front an open app. Do not use when: the app is not open (use app_open), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «bring chrome to the front», «switch to the word window», «focus spotify».
tools.window.maximize: Maximize an already identified window. A windowId expires after 5 minutes (invalid_or_expired_window_id). Use when: maximize or enlarge the window. Do not use when: back to normal size (use window_restore), fullscreen video in the browser (use browser_control). Examples: «maximize chrome», «make the window bigger», «maximize word». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.minimize: Minimize one already identified window, not all. A windowId expires after 5 minutes (invalid_or_expired_window_id). Use when: minimize X or this window. Do not use when: minimizing everything to show the desktop (use window_minimize_all), closing it (use app_close). Examples: «minimize spotify», «minimize this window», «minimize chrome». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.minimize.all: Minimize all windows of this desktop except BAXY's own to show the desktop (allMinimized says whether none of the others is left), closing nothing; windows on another virtual desktop are not touched (cloakedWindows counts them); a desktop window that could not be read is counted in unreadWindows. Use when: minimize everything or show me the desktop. Do not use when: one window or one named application (use window_minimize), closing all windows (use window_close_all). Examples: «minimize everything», «show me the desktop», «minimize all».
tools.window.move: Move an already identified window to another position on the screen (x, y). Use when: move the window to a position. Do not use when: the left or right half (use window_snap), changing its size (use window_resize). Examples: «move chrome to the top left», «move the window to 100, 100», «move notepad to the corner». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.resize: Resize an already identified window to a given width and height. Use when: change the size to N by M. Do not use when: maximizing (use window_maximize), half the screen (use window_snap). Examples: «make the window 800 by 600», «change the size of notepad to 1024x768», «resize chrome to 1280x720». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.resolve: List the open windows of an application or process, each with its windowId, title, state and whether it is in front. Use when: you need the windowId of an open app's window to focus, maximize, minimize, restore, snap, move or resize it. Do not use when: only whether the app is open (use window_application_status), the window in front (use window_active). Examples: «maximize chrome» (resolve chrome, then window_maximize), «put notepad on the left», «minimize spotify».
tools.window.restore: Return an already identified minimized or maximized window to its normal size. Use when: restore or return the window to its size. Do not use when: only bringing it to front (use window_focus), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «restore the chrome window», «put spotify back to normal size», «restore word». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.snap: Place an already identified window on the left or right half of the screen. A windowId expires after 5 minutes (invalid_or_expired_window_id). Use when: put X on the left or on the right. Do not use when: exact coordinates (use window_move), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «put chrome on the left», «send word to the right half», «snap spotify right». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.office.format.apply: Give a format (bold, italic, underline, or align left, center or right) to what the person has open in Word or Excel, through the open application itself, and read it back; it opens nothing. In Word it formats the selected text, the document's title (target title) or a paragraph by its number (target paragraph with paragraph); in Excel the selection, a whole row (target row with row), a whole column (target column with column) or cells (target cells with an address like A1:C3), which it leaves selected. Use when: the person asks for a format in Word or Excel (bold, italic, underline, center, align). Do not use when: writing text (use input_text_type), another application (look at its window and click its button). Examples: «make the selection bold in word», «in excel make row 1 bold», «underline column B in excel», «center the title in word».

baxy.settings.set.value: With proposals: 30m, 1h, tomorrow (until 08:00 tomorrow: «till tomorrow», «until tomorrow») or on (ends the silence). With tool_profile: esencial, diario, avanzado or completo. With language: spanish or english. Every other setting takes on or off.

browser.control.tab: Only with close or switch_tab: the tab to close or to go to, by the words of its title the person said («the runpod one»: runpod; «the YouTube one»: YouTube). Without it close closes the active tab. user_browser_tab_not_found or user_browser_tab_ambiguous: nothing was closed or switched; tabs (and candidates) are the titles read.

media.play.youtube.query: What to search, in the person's own words: every name of a person, channel or title exactly as they said it, even one you do not know (never another that sounds alike).

file.write.path: Where to write, as the person said it: their full path (C:\Users\ana\Projects\notes.txt), a folder and the file (Documents/notes.txt; Projects/notes.txt is in their home), or only its name. Keep every folder they named and add none.
file.write.append: true adds the text as a new last line («add at the end») and keeps the file.
file.write.expectedSha256: Only to replace a file that exists: the fileSha256 file_read gave for it. version_conflict means the file exists, or the fileSha256 given is not that of the file there now: read it first, or use append.
file.write.text: At most 1 MiB (UTF-8); a longer text is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is written.

filesystem.create.directory.path: The new folder as the person said it: a full path, a known folder and the new one (Documents/Projects), or a folder of their home (Projects/2024). Keep every folder they named and add none.

file.read.path: The file as the person said it: a full path, a folder and the file (Desktop/notes.txt; Projects/notes.txt is in their home), or only its name, then looked for in Desktop, Documents and Downloads. Keep every folder they named and add none.
file.read.offset: Where to go on reading the same file: the nextOffset its last result gave (hasMore true). Without it the file starts again from the beginning.

file.find.path: The folder to look in as the person said it: a known folder (Downloads, Documents) with any subfolder (Documents/Trips), a folder of their home (BAXY-bench), or a full path. Leave it out only when they named no folder.

file.edit.path: The file as the person said it: a full path, a folder and the file (Desktop/notes.txt; Projects/notes.txt is in their home), or only its name, then looked for in Desktop, Documents and Downloads. Keep every folder they named and add none.
file.edit.newText: At most 65,536 bytes (UTF-8); a longer text is refused (invalid arguments) and the file is left as it was.

filesystem.known.trash.named.path: The file or folder as the person said it: a full path, a folder and its name (Desktop/old.txt; BAXY-bench/old.txt is in their home), or only its name, then looked for in Desktop, Documents and Downloads. Keep every folder they named and add none.

file.compress.path: The file or folder as the person said it, with all its words, after the known folder it is in (Desktop/House plans, Documents/report.docx), or its full path.

game.entitlement.named.store: The store the person named; when they named none, leave it out (Steam is looked up) rather than asking.

filesystem.folder.open.path: The folder as the person said it: a known folder (Downloads, Documents), a folder inside one (Documents/Trips), one of their home (BAXY-bench), or a full path.

filesystem.sandbox.move.named.path: Only for a file of the person's: the folder it is in, as they said it (Documents, BAXY-bench/invoices, or a full path). Leave it out for BAXY's work folder.
filesystem.sandbox.move.named.copy: true makes a copy and keeps the file where it is («copy», «duplicate»).

filesystem.explorer.count.path: The folder as the person said it (Desktop, Documents/invoices, BAXY-bench, or a full path). Leave it out for this folder or here: the File Explorer window in front.

media.control.sourceApp: Only to control a player other than what is playing now: its sourceAppUserModelId exactly as a media_status result gave it (media_status names only the session it reports). Leave it out to control what is playing.

input.key.press.target: Where the keyboard is: message_composer when the focused field holds a message to someone, so Enter or Space sends it (BAXY then asks the person first); text_field when it is any other text field, so Delete only erases characters (without it, Delete deletes what is selected and BAXY asks first). Leave it out otherwise.
input.key.press.onto: The exact label, as your last look showed it, of the control Enter or Space presses (the focused button, or the result chosen in a list). A control that sends, joins a call, buys or deletes makes BAXY ask the person first. Leave it out when the key presses no control.
input.key.press.consequence: irreversible when the control the key presses pays, buys, orders, subscribes, donates, or deletes or uninstalls for good, wherever its name says so; overwrite when the key confirms replacing a file that already exists (Enter on the focused «Yes» of «Do you want to replace it?»). Either makes BAXY ask the person first. Leave it out otherwise.

input.visible.click.consequence: irreversible when the click pays, buys, orders, subscribes, donates, or deletes or uninstalls for good, wherever the control's name says so (a long name counts as a whole); overwrite when it confirms replacing a file that already exists (the «Yes» of «Do you want to replace it?»). Either makes BAXY ask the person first. null for every other click.
input.visible.click.search: Text to type into the search box the click opens, in the same step; then the result named exactly as that text (or as choose) is pressed. If none is, nothing is pressed and the names seen are returned.
input.visible.click.choose: With search: the exact name of the result to press among those the search shows. Judged like a label: one that sends, joins a call, buys or deletes makes BAXY ask the person first.
input.visible.click.manner: How to press it: double (double click), menu (open its context menu), open (only open its drop-down or split arrow). Leave it out for a normal click.
input.visible.click.controlId: The controlIdentity a click result gave for that control. A look gives no id: for a control of your last look pass its index, not here.

memory.recall.selector: With scope exact: the name the memory was saved under (as memory_list shows it). Case, accents and repeated or edge spaces do not matter; a part of the name, or the name with its inner spaces removed, does not match: with no exact match, what is remembered comes back instead (the first 20 and the total), to tell which one answers.

input.visible.controls.wanted: Words of what you look for in that window (a name, a button). The view keeps sixty controls; with these words, up to ten more whose names have one of them as a whole word are added after those. Leave it out for the usual view.
input.visible.controls.tail: true to keep the last entries of a long window (a conversation's newest messages) when the view is cut, instead of the first ones.
input.visible.controls.includeText: true to also read the text written on screen (what controls do not name: a notice, a message, a number drawn on the window).

web.fetch.offset: Where to go on reading the same page: the nextOffset its last result gave (hasMore true). Without it the page starts again from the beginning.

audio.device.set.device: The words of the device's name the person said that tell it apart (its brand or model, as said or as audio_device_list shows it), not a word every device could have like headphones or speakers, unless that is all they said.

audio.volume.level: The level the person wants the volume at, 0 to 100: the number after «to», «at», «up to» or «down to», also with raise or lower.

audio.volume.adjust.amount: How much to change it from where it is now, when the person gave no level to end at: the number they said («up 10», «down 5»), or 10 when they said no number.

audio.mute.scope: What is silenced: "pc" is all the PC's sound (the PC, the computer, notebook or laptop, the speakers, headphones or headset, the sound in general); "app" is one application, or any other name said as what to silence, even one you do not know: its name goes in app, and the result says whether it has sound.
audio.mute.app: With scope app: the name the person said as what to silence (spotify, discord, chrome), as they said it.

audio.app.volume.set.app: The application the person named, whose own volume changes (spotify, discord, chrome). The PC, the computer or the volume in general is not an application: that is audio_volume.

audio.app.volume.adjust.amount: How much to change it from where it is now, when the person gave no level to end at: the number they said («up 10», «down 5»), or 10 when they said no number.
audio.app.volume.adjust.app: The application the person named, whose own volume changes (spotify, discord, chrome). The PC, the computer or the volume in general is not an application: that is audio_volume_adjust.

app.open.place: A section to open directly, only for an app that declares it: {app_places}.

wifi.connect.named.place: casa (home), oficina (office) or trabajo (work) whenever the person said one.
wifi.connect.named.profileName: The network's name; when only a place was said, repeat that word.

note.read.title: The note's title as the person said it.

note.trash.expectedTitle: Only with noteId, as the call of the last note_trash result gives it.
note.trash.expectedRevision: Only with noteId, as the call of the last note_trash result gives it.
note.trash.expectedIsTrashed: Only with noteId, as the call of the last note_trash result gives it.

file.open.path: The file as the person said it: a full path, a folder and the file (Downloads/receipt.pdf; Projects/report.docx is in their home), or only its name.

weather.current.dialectCountry: The country the person's own way of speaking marks (AR, CL, CO, ES, MX or VE), only when it is clear; leave it out otherwise. It only chooses among places of the same name and comparable size (Valencia in Spain or in Venezuela); the result then says namesakesElsewhere: true, so name the country read. A place, region or country the person said goes in location instead.

input.text.type.replacing: The part to change, exactly as written there (capitals and accents included); it must be there exactly once, or nothing changes.
input.text.type.text: At most 4,096 characters and 8,192 bytes (UTF-8), with no line break or tab (each is a key of its own: input_key_press); a longer text or one with them is refused and nothing is typed.

email.send.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer body is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is sent.

email.latest.reply.expectedMessageId: The messageId email_latest_read gave for the email being answered. The reply goes only to that email: if a newer one arrived, nothing is sent and the result names the newest. Without it the reply may first be refused with the newest email's messageId to pass here.
email.latest.reply.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer reply is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is sent.

message.draft.channel: The app the person named, now, just before or in their answer to your question; never one they did not name. With none named, ask them which.
message.draft.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer message is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is written.

message.send.channel: The app the person named, now, just before or in their answer to your question; never one they did not name. With none named, ask them which.
message.send.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer message is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is sent.

client.channel.open.server: Only for a Discord server's channel: the server's name as the person said it; never for a direct chat or for WhatsApp.

message.send.test.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer message is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is sent.

clipboard.write.text.text: At most 65,536 characters; a longer text is refused (invalid arguments) and the clipboard is left as it was.

memory.save.retention: persistent (without expiryPolicy), session (with expiryPolicy session_end: forgotten when the session ends) or temporary (with expiryPolicy after_relevance_window: forgotten after 24 hours); any other pairing is refused and nothing is saved.

memory.sensitive.save.retention: persistent (without expiryPolicy), session (with expiryPolicy session_end: forgotten when the session ends) or temporary (with expiryPolicy after_relevance_window: forgotten after 24 hours); any other pairing is refused and nothing is saved.

office.format.apply.app: word or excel: the application the person has open.
office.format.apply.cells: With target cells: the cells' address (A1:C3).
office.format.apply.column: With target column: the column's letter (column A is A).
office.format.apply.on: false to remove that format (remove the bold); leave it out to apply it.
office.format.apply.paragraph: With target paragraph: the paragraph's number, counted from the top (1 is the first).
office.format.apply.row: With target row: the row's number (row 1 is 1).
office.format.apply.style: bold, italic, underline, center, left or right.
office.format.apply.target: Leave it out for what is selected. Word: title or paragraph. Excel: row, column or cells.

system.power.action: lock: the session locks behind the lock screen, which asks for the password, and everything stays open (lock). signout: the person's Windows session ends and its applications close; the PC stays on (sign out, log off). sleep: the PC suspends and wakes as it was (sleep). restart: the PC turns off and on again (restart). shutdown: the PC turns off; only for turn off or shut down.

desktop.wallpaper.set.path: For an image: the image as the person said it, after the known folder it is in (Pictures/beach.jpg), or its full path.

schedule.alarms.id: Only with stop or snooze: the id of the one ringing now, as the turn's note gives it.

system.time.daysFromToday: Whole days from today to the day asked about; negative for days ago.
system.time.month: The month of the date asked about, 1 to 12; always with day.
system.time.day: The day of the month of the date asked about; always with month.
system.time.year: Only when the person says a year. Without it the result gives that date's coming one (coming) and its last one before today (last).
system.time.weekday: The weekday asked about, in English. The result gives its last date before today (last), the coming one (coming) and the one in next week (inNextWeek).
